label: Foundation, accompaniment and a coexisting term do not give concurrent actualization
paraphrase: Closed result, attribution deferred: it is not the case that, for every history over a preordered time, giving relation, origin relation and reception predicate, foundation of the origin relation on received esse, accompaniment, coexistence of the term and received onset being given (fa3e228b) together entail weak concurrent actualization 40a97664. Witness: Control part 1, in which a creator is present at every moment and gives a received-esse thing being at its first moment only, and the thing keeps its relation to the creator afterwards. So the warrant that a real relation has an existing term, which is independent of 40a97664, does not reach giving at the moment.
